headline: Iran Airstrikes Draw UN War Crimes Allegations as Regional War Widens
subheadline: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Yaroslavl refinery and Rostov airfield while a Russia-China UN veto and a Hormuz tanker incident deepen regional instability.
lede: A UN fact-finding mission accused the United States of war crimes after two airstrikes on Iran killed at least 178 civilians, including approximately 120 children at a Minab school. The IDF used precision munitions to kill two Hamas Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza, while Israeli jets struck southern Lebanon and artillery shelling was reported in three locations. In Ukraine, drones hit the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl and the Rostov-on-Don Central military airfield, while Russian waves struck 36 locations and injured 25 people. A DeepState map showed advances near Bilytske, while Russian reporting cited captures at Rozovka and Malaya Volchya.

sections.title: Ukraine Strikes Deep Into Russian Strategic Infrastructure
sections.body: Ukrainian drones struck the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl and the Rostov-on-Don Central military airfield, causing major fires. Russia launched drone waves across 36 Ukrainian locations overnight, injuring 16 in Kyiv, six in Odesa and three in Zaporizhzhia. Russian air defenses said they had shot down 292 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and the Black and Caspian seas. A DeepState map showed advances near Bilytske, while Russian reporting said forces captured Rozovka in Zaporizhzhia and Malaya Volchya in Kharkiv.

sections.title: Iran Strikes and Maritime Threats Escalate Regional Risk
sections.body: A UN fact-finding mission accused the United States of war crimes after two airstrikes killed at least 178 civilians, including approximately 120 children at a Minab school and 22 at Lamard. The IDF killed Hamas Nukhba commanders Shreef Shadi Ibrahim Labad and Yosef Saad Al-Eddin Radha in northern Gaza, while Israeli jets struck Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Bani Haiyan and shelling was reported in three southern Lebanese locations. Russia and China vetoed a US draft to extend the Iran sanctions committee under resolution 1737, with 11 votes in favor and abstentions by Pakistan and Somalia. The IRGC targeted the oil tanker Trend in the Hormuz Strait, logged 16 nautical miles northeast of Khor Al Adaid, while US Treasury sanctioned Babak Zanjani for channeling hundreds of millions to the IRGC through a Hormuz network.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Long-range strikes against energy and military infrastructure are occurring alongside ground advances, indicating that pressure is widening across both theaters. In the Middle East, the failed sanctions extension, the Trend incident in Hormuz and Trump's pending decision on resuming large-scale Iran operations signal a high-risk threshold between diplomacy and escalation. Gulf state coordination at the UN General Assembly could shape whether diplomacy or escalation dominates the next phase.
